xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4727: gstack as a skill pack: full runtime from the eltmon/gstack fork, toggle at global/project/issue level, clean removal

plan.title: gstack as a skill pack: full runtime from the eltmon/gstack fork, toggle at global/project/issue level, clean removal
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 29 files_scope entries, 10 of them in a different repository (the eltmon/gstack fork, prefixed gstack-fork/). The Overdeck surface is 19 files in src/lib/skill-packs, src/lib/skill-overrides, src/cli and docs. The fork's pack-mode contract and the Overdeck adapter must ship together for the acceptance run, and a sibling issue in this tracker could not carry a PR for another repo.

narratives.Problem: gstack's skills call ~/.claude/skills/gstack/bin/* by absolute path and its ./setup writes ~/.claude settings hooks, harness skill dirs and ~/.gstack. Overdeck's pack mount copies only skill directories, so gstack skills cannot run as a pack, and installing gstack normally cannot be turned off per project or removed cleanly.
narratives.Proposal: Add a network-free pack mode to the eltmon/gstack fork (setup --pack-root R --pack-state-root S) that renders every skill and its bash/bun runtime into R, keeps state in S via a marker file, and writes nothing else. Add a gstack-runtime adapter in Overdeck: a reviewed skill map with default/opt-in/excluded/needs-binary classes, a consent preview that lists the render command and every executable, a render after consent in add/update/sync, mounts built from the render root for Claude Code and Codex, and remove/gc that delete the render, the state, mounts and Codex caches. The existing global/project/issue/conversation resolver is unchanged.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Building browse/design/make-pdf, bun install, Playwright, or mounting the 21 needs-binary skills (PAN-4730)
- Installing any of gstack setup's settings hooks (plan-tune, timeline Stop, SessionStart auto-update, verify-gate) or MCP servers
- A Codex-specific gstack render
- Setting GSTACK_SESSION_KIND or any gstack env var in Overdeck launches
- Deleting project-local .gstack/ or .gstack-worktrees/ directories
- Merging or tagging the fork PR, or any issue, PR, comment or push to garrytan/*
- Dashboard UI changes
- Renaming or retiring bundled Overdeck skills that share a name with gstack skills
- Auto-updating gstack (gstack-upgrade stays excluded)
- Touching src/lib/launcher-generator.ts

autoDecisions.summary: A1: Pack mode never runs bun install, bun run build or Playwright, so the 21 skills that call the compiled $B/$D/$P binaries (qa, browse, ship, design-* …) are classified needs-binary and not mounted; follow-up PAN-4730 adds an opt-in browser runtime.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's scope requires no network calls at setup and names --no-browser; the acceptance names only test-audit and deslop-shared-libs. The operator's 'qa should work' note conflicts with no-network setup, so the network-free core ships now and the browser runtime gets its own consented step and issue.

autoDecisions.summary: A2: State root comes from a marker file in the render (R/.gstack-pack-state-root) read by the fork's resolver, not from launch env vars.
autoDecisions.rationale: Works for Claude Code, Codex and hand-run scripts with zero launcher changes; Codex has no general per-pack env path today (only Deft's two-line allowlist).

autoDecisions.summary: A3: Render root ~/.overdeck/packs/gstack/render/<commit>/ and state root ~/.overdeck/packs/gstack/state/, both inside the pack cache dir.
autoDecisions.rationale: removePack already rm -rf's packs/<id>/, so removal covers both with no new path logic; the issue's example path was illustrative.

autoDecisions.summary: A4: Skill classes per PRD §6: 22 default, 14 opt-in (push/deploy, paid or cloud APIs, Codex upload, blocking hooks), 6 excluded (gstack-upgrade, setup-gbrain, sync-gbrain, plan-tune, setup-deploy, connect-chrome), 21 needs-binary; unknown names excluded as unreviewed.
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the issue's candidate list and the Deft unreviewed-by-default pattern; investigate stays default because its hooks allow by default and the operator named it.

autoDecisions.summary: A5: Codex mounts the same Claude-host render; no Codex-specific render.
autoDecisions.rationale: Rendered paths are absolute and work from the Codex plugin cache copy; one mount serves both harnesses as today.

autoDecisions.summary: A6: The work agent pushes branch overdeck/pack-mode to eltmon/gstack and opens a PR inside the fork; it never merges, tags, or contacts garrytan/*. KNOWN_PACKS carries no pinned commit; docs use --ref main.
autoDecisions.rationale: Fork-first policy (PAN-4424); the trusted commit is the operator's consent at add time; gh push permission on eltmon/gstack was verified during planning.

autoDecisions.summary: A7: Live acceptance runs with the workspace build in an isolated OVERDECK_HOME with a scratch project and claude -p --plugin-dir probes, not managed launches.
autoDecisions.rationale: The deployed pan lacks the new adapter until merge, and an isolated home keeps the operator's real config, toggles and projects untouched.

autoDecisions.summary: A8: remove lists, but does not delete, project-local .gstack/ and .gstack-worktrees/ dirs that invoked skills wrote.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows project-local writes by skills the operator invokes; they can hold the operator's reports and .gstack-worktrees are git worktrees, so deleting them silently is destructive.

autoDecisions.summary: A9: The changelog entry goes in CHANGELOG.md '## Unreleased', not changelog.mdx.
autoDecisions.rationale: changelog.mdx is written by the release step (docs/RELEASING.md; PAN-4424 WI-3 precedent).

items.title: Fork: add `setup --pack-root/--pack-state-root` pack-mode renderer

narrative.Action: Work in the fork clone $HOME/Projects/gstack on branch overdeck/pack-mode (create per PRD §7 preamble: clone https://github.com/eltmon/gstack if absent, `git switch -c overdeck/pack-mode origin/main`; if the clone exists dirty or with another origin, stop and pan tell flywheel-orchestrator). files_scope paths prefixed gstack-fork/ are relative to that clone (setup* = only the setup script, bin/gstack-paths* = only bin/gstack-paths; globs only because the lint needs a filename-like segment; never edit setup.ps1). Never touch garrytan/*. Implement PRD WI-F1 exactly: parse --pack-root/--pack-state-root in setup's parser (lines 213-239) and exec scripts/pack-render.sh right after the parser loop, before any other setup step; pack-render.sh validates both paths against ^/[A-Za-z0-9_.@+/-]*$ (exit 2 otherwise), copies the source tree into R without .git/, test/, node_modules/, .github/ and deletes every symlink under R, runs `bun run R/scripts/gen-skill-docs.ts --host claude --out-dir R --install-root R --link-root R` with cwd R, checks R/test-audit/SKILL.md names R/bin/gstack-skill-start, writes R/.gstack-pack-state-root (absolute S), seeds S/config.yaml (telemetry: off, update_check: false, auto_upgrade: false) only when absent, and writes R/.gstack-pack.json {packMode:1,stateRoot,version} last. Add '${HOME}/.claude/skills/gstack' to rewriteInstallRoot's Claude defaults. Add pack-mode.json = {"packMode": 1}. Follow the WI-F1 implementation checkpoint for sections. Never run bun install, bun run build, Playwright, or write outside R and S. Commit in the fork, then record the fork SHA in .pan/drafts/PAN-4727-live-checkpoint.md and commit that here with the Item trailer.
